# Plot a Thurstonian IRT response function

Draws a probability from
[`prob_tirt()`](https://sedzinfo.github.io/golemirt/reference/prob_tirt.md)
or its pair and intercept forms against the trait, with a marker at
every value and a gray line at 0.5.

## Usage

``` r
plot_tirt(eta, p)
```

## Arguments

- eta:

  Numeric vector of trait values.

- p:

  Probabilities, one for each value of `eta`.

## Value

A `plotly` object.

## Examples

``` r
eta <- seq(-6, 6, by = 0.1)
plot_tirt(eta, prob_tirt(eta))
```
